en.description:
POCKETREX - Your Fitness Tamagotchi on Apple Watch

Turn every step into an adventure! PocketRex is a virtual companion that lives or dies based on your daily physical activity.

THE CONCEPT

Adopt a virtual dinosaur directly on your Apple Watch. But beware: your dino needs YOU to survive! Every step you take keeps it fit. Stay inactive and it will lose muscle... until it's gone.

HOW IT WORKS

Your steps equal your dino's muscles. The more you walk, the more fit and muscular it becomes. The less you move, the weaker it gets. Three days of inactivity means Game Over.

It's simple: move to keep it alive!

FEATURES

Random Hatching
Each egg can give you a dino of different rarity: Common, Rare, Gold, Platinum, or Mythic. Will you be lucky enough to get a Mythic?

Real-time Statistics
Track muscle percentage, weight, health score, steps today, floors climbed, calories burned, and distance traveled.

Unique Personalities
Your dino can be Athletic, Lazy, Hungry, or Balanced. Each personality affects its progression!

Dynamic Moods
Happy, Neutral, Tired, or Sad - its mood reflects your efforts.

Global Leaderboard
Compare your dino with others from around the world! Climb the leaderboard by keeping your dino alive as long as possible.

Candy System
Earn candies by reaching your goals. Use them for boosts: Protein Shake, Vitamins, Protective Shield and more.

Lucky Wheel
Try your luck to win bonus candies!

Cemetery
Honor the memory of your fallen dinos. Each deceased dino is preserved with its statistics.

Progress Charts
Track your dino's evolution with detailed graphs.

Day and Night Cycle
The background changes based on real time with a sun during the day and falling stars at night.

DESIGNED FOR APPLE WATCH

PocketRex is optimized for Apple Watch. Check on your dino at a glance, right from your wrist. The companion iPhone app displays detailed statistics.

DAILY GOALS

5,000 steps for maintenance. 10,000 steps for optimal growth. 15,000 or more steps for a super muscular dino!

Stairs count double for muscle. Take the stairs!

WHY POCKETREX?

Gamified motivation works. When your dino depends on you, every step counts. No more excuses: your little companion is counting on you!

Join players from around the world and keep your dino alive. How many days will you last?

Requires Apple Watch with watchOS 10 or later.
Respects your privacy - HealthKit data used only for gameplay.

Download now and start the adventure!
